key_values.surface_metric_scope: Sentinel-2 dNBR post window is 2023-07-01 to 2023-09-29, beyond the 2023-08-31 event lock; surface metrics are scored only as available comparison metrics, not strict event-window burn-perimeter proof.

primary_gt.computed_consequence: The ledger favors a regional smoke-transport chain; burn-surface metrics are mixed because only the maximum dNBR and scene-count ratio pass.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics including viirs_date, text_gates, scores, score_comparison, margin, answer, and computed_consequence.
criteria.name: Requested JSON structure
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for minor key-name differences that preserve all scored fields.

criteria.description: Extracts late_august_fires_min 24, timing_hours 24, receptor_count 3, weather_terms_count 3, and viirs_date 2023-08-22.
criteria.name: Report metric extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct threshold states with one missing or rounded value.

criteria.description: Sets alexandroupolis_source true, southwest_transport true, and athens_local_cues true.
criteria.name: Report text gates
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for two correct gates.

criteria.description: Uses available surface-comparison metrics: dNBR mean -0.083037, dNBR maximum 0.859705, AlphaEarth mean 0.061316, and post/pre scene ratio 1.64, without treating them as strict event-window burn-perimeter proof.
criteria.name: Surface metrics
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct threshold states with weaker rounding.

criteria.description: Applies the formulas exactly, yielding regional_smoke_chain 8, athens_local_fire_context 3, and burn_surface_mapping 2.
criteria.name: Score arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for one arithmetic error that does not alter the lead label.

criteria.description: Applies the dominance rule with lead_signal regional_smoke_chain, second_signal athens_local_fire_context, low_score_signal burn_surface_mapping, margin 5, and answer regional_smoke_chain_dominant.
criteria.name: Score comparison
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for the right answer with incomplete comparison fields.

criteria.description: Keeps the consequence tied to the computed ledger and avoids extra burned-area, casualty, evacuation, hospital, or asset-loss totals not produced by the calculation.
criteria.name: Bounded computed consequence
criteria.partial_credit: No credit if the answer turns the ledger into a broad narrative.
